name: Mission Control
short_desc: Self-hosted home base for coding agents on your own models
description: Mission Control is a self-hosted home base for coding agents on your own models — task boards, approval gates, a knowledge vault, token and cost insights, and runtimes for Claude Code, vLLM, LM Studio and any OpenAI-compatible API. A first-run wizard walks you through the admin account and an LLM provider, and offers a demo board. The catalog install runs the core stack; agents you steer from the phone chat need the full install described in the project README.
author: argyelan-ai
